title: Operations Control Response 1.0
description: The result of an admin control request. It reports the outcome (applied, rejected because the expected_config_version was stale, or denied), the resulting config_version when applied, and the effective kill-switch document that is now current. It carries no identity, credential, or provider payload.

config_version.description: When applied, the new config_version. When version_conflict or denied, the current stored config_version the caller must reconcile against.

effective.description: The kill-switch document that is current after the request. Present when the outcome is applied.
